scope: One independent RDF traversal counterpart on three already consumed input examples; software integration only, no new trial sample or maintenance benefit measurement.

arms.rdf_pyshacl: Shared Python input guard, RDF conversion, actual pySHACL structural check, independent traversal through RDFLib graph objects

attribution.shared_guard: Schema/type/version/bounds errors rejected before RDF conversion are not SHACL detections.
attribution.shacl: Postconversion node id/version cardinality/datatype and relation target checks; largely redundant on a correct converter, does not discover hidden source dependencies or prove truth.
attribution.traversal: Dependency reachability plus deterministic witness; Python control flow over RDFLib graph, not a graph database, OWL reasoner or LLM query generator.
attribution.coverage: partial from original projection; complete flag only in authored control

inputs: Use unchanged inputs from docs/experiments/records/20261015-workflow-shadow-single.json; retain original Python output history and full new outputs.
limitations: No separate declarative JSON policy evaluator yet
In-process API not hostile-input resource isolated
next_gate: After matching behavior, evaluate one actual rule-change task with setup/adapter/policy/test edits separated; do not keep multiplying parity cases as research efficacy.
